verdict.rationale: Freshsales publishes an API reference listing endpoints such as Create a Lead (/api/leads) and Create a Deal (/api/deals). Nothing in the pack shows that reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404. A static endpoint listing is adjacent to the story, not the interactive, runnable reference it asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
